title: Custom Content Text Editor - Call To Action | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: Custom Content Text Editor - Call To Action Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000079206 Navigate to Settings >> Design Settings >> Homepage >> Top Hero Section >> Search Box / Call to Action > Click on Select Call to Action. Select the Custom Content - Text Editor option: Click to Toggle Text Editor: Lastly, you can add all of the content needed: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
